params.body:
Posts delivered since 11 October use a new layout: a running head on every page ("GENTELLS | Growing Up in Public 3"), markers in the sentences ("[1, 2, 3]"), chart credits ("Sources: Eurostat [1]") and a numbered source list at the end, each entry with its address as a link on the line. `posts-to-json.mjs` read all of that as body text, so the head and the credits landed in the middle of paragraphs, a marker glued two paragraphs together, and the links were lost.

What changes in `bin/posts-to-json.mjs`:

- A line that comes back on most pages with only its number changed is the running head and is dropped.
- The source list leaves the body and comes out as `sources` in the json: number, publisher, title and the address, read from the link annotation on that line.
- The chart credits go; the list names those sources already.
- The markers leave the text; for each one the json keeps the sentence it stood after, exactly as the body reads, in `citations`. That is what the source check and `bin/cite-sources.mjs` need.
- A post without a source list (all posts before 11 October) converts as before. `import-articles.mjs` ignores the two new fields.

Used on 23 October for the nine posts of the 4 and 11 October deliveries (imported as drafts on the box, then dated, published and cited). The four posts of 11 October gave 27 sources with addresses and 20 marked sentences.

Tests: four new cases in `test/post-pdf.test.mjs` (running head, source list with addresses and credits, a post without a list, markers). Full suite 1303/1309; the 6 failures are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm` (not installed on the workbench, also failing on main). Typecheck clean.

Refs #363

params.title: posts-to-json: read the source list of the new post layout
